programs.title: Rajkumar
programs.desc: Two warring kingdoms  Thambore and Araavali  decide to end their enmity by marrying their children. But post a fateful incidence the kingdoms revert to rivalry. Now Araavali prince's love for Thambore's princess is their only hope to end the rivalry.
